receiver: Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct NF4 plus frozen TDIUC standard rank-8 language LoRA
codec: frozen bmshj2018-hyperprior quality 3; long edge 320; existing uniform-gain full packets
pixel_target_policy: equal min/max pixel targets, actual grid-rounded tokens measured, not hard token caps

oracle_baselines.rate_only: max over fixed tiers of mean per-image max over rate utility
oracle_baselines.compute_only: max over fixed rates of mean per-image max over tier utility
oracle_baselines.joint: mean per-image max over all nine configurations utility
oracle_baselines.note: compare joint to strongest single-axis oracle, not merely high-tier or 4k slices

physical_symbols: 510 * ceil(image_packet_bytes / 48); analytical accounting, no noisy channel simulated in grid
delivery: clean cached packet roundtrip only, not wireless delivery
energy: null unless valid hardware energy telemetry; never infer joules from tokens/latency/power limit
receiver_timing_scope: CUDA-synchronized generate, includes vision encoder and language generation, excludes loading/image decompression; preprocessing separate
sealed_test_policy: never read labels or infer test during development; freeze deployable policy and primary comparisons before test

stage3.channel: shared Rician K=6 dB, Es/N0, perfect receiver CSI, LDPC(1020,512)/QPSK, all-fragment CRC, no retransmission
stage3.failure_answer: frozen training-only exact-question majority, otherwise global training majority; all failures retained in denominator
stage3.new_controller_training: only after oracle headroom screen; preregister bounded training on train split, not these development answers
